notes: 28 script-goal behavior/destruction methods plus shared referenced-object release and position resolver form30 reviewed C routines; no original class names asserted.
Original dispatch tables connect these methods to constructor/script bindings recorded in goals.json and script_gameplay.json. Table data itself does not count as C recovery.
Shared partial layouts are extended only by proved accesses, including owner/entity state, scalar output records, referenced-object tagged payload, and signed16 adjusted-this virtual entries.
The complex drive destructor1DC820, idle selector1E06D8, and getter/predicate1E8988 remain external assembly; they were deliberately omitted from this reviewed batch.

Source macros reuse only observed repeated action destructor/success patterns. External function prototypes use explicitly set ABI arguments and callee entry review, excluding stale temporary registers.
Unsigned operations preserve32/16/8-bit wrap where original instructions do. Float comparisons retain unordered behavior and single-step angle wrapping.
GEORGE_SAVE128 is an opt-in annotation on observed nonleaf routines with128-bit saved registers; default recipes expand it to nothing. No inline assembly, backend modification, or byte masking.
Compiler matching is unproved until complete linked bytes and exact symbol size match; manual C review alone is never counted as a match.

Float literal audit derives constant bits from original instructions. The look factor is exactly3C8EFA36 (0.01745329424738884f), one ULP above the usual rounded degree/radian factor; pi/negative pi/2pi are40490FDB/C0490FDB/40C90FDB and random factor38D1B717. All literals in both constructor and method batches checked; original hashes describe original code and are unchanged by source repairs.

Independent full-instruction and layout review passed six exceptional paths:1DA650,1DF548,1E5BA0,1E8818,1CAF88,1CAFE0. Reviewer confirmed exact angle wraps, unsigned low-halfword road index/0x60 stride, owner and reference reloads, untouched-vector gate, full32 loop comparison, per-call signed8 narrowing, signed virtual adjustments, and resolver cases.
